title: Majority Element
summary: Return the number that occurs in strictly more than half of the positions.
statement: Return the number that occurs in strictly more than half of the positions.

examples.explanation: Three of the five entries are 2.
The only value is the majority.
The majority can appear after a different first entry.

constraints: 1–50000 entries in [−1000000000,1000000000]. A majority always exists.
hints: Conceptual: A majority survives the removal of pairs of different values.
Directional: Keep one candidate and a counter for uncancelled votes.
Implementation: Replace the candidate when the counter reaches zero. Increment on matches and decrement otherwise.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
